name: Mac & Cheese Bites with Honey-Mustard Mayo Dipping Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until just tender, about 8 minutes.
Meanwhile, use your fingers to coat a silicone or regular muffin pan with butter. (You can be generous with the butter, the better the pan is coated, the easier the mac & cheese bites will come out!)
Place bread crumbs, Parmesan, and seasoning in a small bowl. Stir to combine the topping and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup panko bread crumbs
⅓ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
1 tsp garlic & herb seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Place milk, egg, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅔ cup whole milk
1 egg
1 ½ tsp garlic & herb seasoning
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is done, drain and return to the pot. Add milk mixture, cheese, and butter. Return pot to medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, until cheese is melted and pasta is coated in sauce, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups shredded cheese, mac & cheese blend
butter, unsalted

instructions.primary_message: Using a 1/4-cup measure, fill muffin cups with macaroni and cheese, then sprinkle with the topping. Place in the oven and bake until golden and firm, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly, 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, place dressing and mayo in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the dipping sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup honey mustard dressing
¼ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Arrange mac and cheese bites on a platter. Serve with honey-mustard mayo for dipping and enjoy!
